purpose: Does enabling the analyzer's LLM fallback improve cross-generator transfer on the frozen matched manifest?

llm.determinism: Greedy decoding (temperature 0.0). Verified empirically: 5 repeats of 3 utterances returned byte-identical state, confidence and free-text evidence; a 12-example probe at 4-way concurrency matched the sequential result 12/12.
llm.system_prompt: You classify a student's cognitive state from their think-aloud. Respond with JSON only, no prose.
llm.parser: strip ``` fences -> json.loads -> regex {.*} fallback; an out-of-vocabulary state falls back to substring match, then to the heuristic verdict
llm.failure_behaviour: any exception or missing ollama returns None and the heuristic verdict stands
